name: app-6a9c857a537081919998169670afa101
description: Create AI videos, images, finished ads and short dramas; hand a campaign to the video agent, plan on boards, research competitor ads, and track every job.

positive.description: Choose a model and quote a clip before anything runs
positive.prompt: Which AI video model should I use for a 10-second vertical product clip, and what will it cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the video models that fit a 10-second vertical clip with each one's credit cost, returns one quote for the chosen model and settings, and starts no generation.

positive.description: Storyboard an ad and render it live on a board
positive.prompt: On a new board, storyboard a 15-second vertical ad for a minimal desk lamp: three shots as Seedream 5.0 Pro images, then turn each shot into a 5-second Seedance 2.0 Fast video at 720p on the same board. Tell me the total cost first, and show me the board full screen while it renders.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a board with three Seedream 5.0 Pro image cards, one per shot, and three Seedance 2.0 Fast video cards (5 seconds, 720p) that each open on their shot's frame (add_generation_card with from_card_id). Quotes every card and states the total, about 105 credits (three frames at 6 and three clips at 29), then waits for a yes. Renders the three frames, then each clip once its frame is done. The one board view, opened full screen, updates by itself: new cards appear in place, rendering cards show a developing animation and each finished image and video appears in its card. Credits are charged per card, on success only.

positive.description: Write and price a one-episode drama without rendering
positive.prompt: Write a one-episode, 15-second vertical drama about a waiter who is secretly the hotel's new owner. Show me the script and the price, but don't render it.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts the drama and shows its card. The draft takes 3 to 5 minutes, so get_drama is polled until the script is ready; the draft is accepted and the per-clip price table is shown. Nothing is rendered; the draft costs 1 to 3 credits.

positive.description: Plan a finished ad and price it without making it
positive.prompt: Plan a 15-second vertical ad for a minimal desk lamp: write the storyboard and tell me what the finished ad would cost. Don't make it yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Picks an ad format, writes a shot-by-shot storyboard with the spoken lines and on-screen text, and returns the most the finished ad can cost with a quote. Nothing is generated and no credits are spent.

positive.description: Start a drop and stop at its first decision
positive.prompt: Start a drop for a launch week of short videos for a desk lamp. Ask me what you need, then stop when a step needs credits.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts the drop, relays its intake questions and the answers, then shows the drop card with its phase steps and the first decision with its price. Nothing is approved and no credits are spent; the planning turn can take about a minute.

negative.description: Editing a file on the person's own computer is outside the plugin: it says so and calls no tool
negative.prompt: Remove the background music from a video file on my laptop.

negative.description: General knowledge is answered without the plugin
negative.prompt: What will the weather be in Nicosia tomorrow?

negative.description: No commerce inside the plugin: at most the informational page https://aicontentdrop.com/plans is offered
negative.prompt: Add 500 more credits to my account.

review.commerce_description: The plugin spends an existing credit balance and never sells credits or plans. Every paid step is quoted first and charged only on success; the only link it offers about plans is the informational page https://aicontentdrop.com/plans.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.3.7: packages review information in the portable root manifest, including the walkthrough video and current test cases. Includes videos, images, finished ads, boards, competitor research, short dramas and Drop, the video agent. Media creation requires confirmation of its quoted credit cost.

interface.longDescription: Choose a model and watch the finished video or image appear in the conversation. Write and produce a short vertical drama episode by episode, hand a whole campaign to Drop, the video agent, turn a brief into a finished captioned ad, lay the work out on a board you can open full screen, and research the ads competitors run. Nothing is made until you confirm it, and a step that fails uses nothing. Browse models anonymously; sign in to create and see your history.
